response: Hi! Let’s get this sorted out. Can you tell me which iOS version you’re on and if you updated recently? It would help to know how long a full charge lasts for you and what you’ve tried so far (restart, reset network, etc.). In the meantime, try closing unused apps, disabling background refresh, and checking Battery > Battery Usage to see if anything’s draining power unusually. We’ll keep digging until your iPhone X feels cool and your texts stay on point.
